name: mynah-whatsapp-bridge
description: WhatsApp transport for Mynah. Vendored from NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT) — see PROVENANCE.md. Transport only: the agent is Sources/SageVoiceCore.
comment:versions: Pinned exactly, no carets. Every other third-party thing this app ships is
pinned to a version and a SHA (see scripts/provision-typst.sh), and a range
here would mean the bundle in a signed release is not the bundle anybody
tested. package-lock.json is committed for the same reason.
Measured working on Node v22.22.0, macOS 15.x arm64, 7 August 2026.
comment:sharp: sharp is NOT listed here and that is deliberate, not an omission.
It is a non-optional peer dependency of Baileys — peerDependenciesMeta
marks audio-decode, jimp and link-preview-js optional, and sharp is not
among them — so a plain `npm install` pulls it in along with libvips:
27 MB of a 55 MB tree, and the only native binary in it.
scripts/provision-whatsapp-bridge.sh is where the exclusion happens, and
it re-checks that the bridge still starts afterwards rather than trusting
this note. Measured 7 Aug 2026: without sharp the bridge still reaches a
pairing QR. The limit of that measurement is that it STARTS. Whether a
media send needs sharp for thumbnails is untested and belongs to the media
phase, where a real send can answer it.
